name: Local SEO By Ankit Rawat
author: Ankit Rawat

sections.description:
Local SEO By Ankit Rawat helps local businesses improve their search engine visibility by adding structured data to their website. This plugin is simple to use, highly customizable, and includes features like:

  • Add Local Business schema using JSON-LD.
  • Configure your business name, address, contact details, and opening hours.
  • Add your business logo and a gallery of images.
  • Include social media profiles to enhance trust and visibility.

Whether you’re running a small business or managing multiple locations, this plugin simplifies local SEO.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/local-seo-by-ankit-rawat directory or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to “Local SEO By Ankit Rawat” in the WordPress admin menu to configure the settings.
  4. Enter your business details and enable schema generation.
sections.faq:
What is JSON-LD and why is it important?

JSON-LD is a method of encoding linked data using JavaScript Object Notation (JSON). It helps search engines better understand your website’s content, which can lead to improved rankings.

Can I use this plugin for multiple locations?

Currently, the plugin supports a single location. Multi-location support may be considered in future updates.

What happens if I disable the plugin?

Disabling the plugin will stop adding the JSON-LD schema to your website, but it will not affect the rest of your website’s functionality.

How can I test the schema data?

You can use Google’s Structured Data Testing Tool or Rich Results Test to verify the schema added by the plugin.
